hero.title:
Stargazer
Interpreter
hero.tagline: Where Lenormand meets geometry. A reading engine that turns Stargazer oracle prompts into exquisite visual artifacts — A4 PDF, web pages, and social cards.
hero.design_credit: Kami-inspired design · Geometric Silence deck · Chiron Sung HK typography
features.heading: Features
features.title: Everything you need to interpret and present
features.subtitle: From a Stargazer prompt to a polished reading — fully automated.
features.card1_desc: Yes/No · 2-Card · 3-Card · 5-Card · 9-Card Box · A-or-B Choice — all supported with dedicated interpretation frameworks.
features.card2_desc: Automatically detects Chinese or English prompts. All output — interpretation text, chapter titles, card names — matches the prompt's language.
features.card3_desc: Adjacent card pairs chain-read using the Noun+Adjective model. Center-card dominance in odd-number spreads. Neutral, honest tone — no empty reassurance.
features.card4_desc: Kami-styled A4 PDF · Self-contained web page · 1080×1440 social card carousel. Generate from one reading, regenerate anytime.
features.card5_desc: Every reading saved as structured JSON + human-readable Markdown. List, query, and regenerate into any product type later.
features.card6_desc: 36 SVG cards in architectural blueprint style. Muted sage green on warm parchment, with dusty rose accents. Pure geometric abstraction.
workflow.heading: How It Works
workflow.title: Three phases, one reading
workflow.step1_desc: Strip the Stargazer prefix, detect language & spread type, extract cards, dates, and verdict — structured data, ready to interpret.
workflow.step2_desc: Combination-first reading with center dominance. Saved as JSON + Markdown. Full-length prose, PDF-ready.
workflow.step3_desc: Copy seed HTML, fill placeholders, render to A4 PDF, web page, or 1080×1440 social cards. One reading, any product.
showcase.heading: Product Showcase
showcase.title: See what you'll get
showcase.subtitle: Real readings, real output. Three product types from the same interpretation.
showcase.pdf_desc: A4 PDF — Kami-inspired design: warm parchment background, ink-blue accents, Chiron Sung HK typography. Cover page with card grid, interpretation chapters with combination blocks and takeaway boxes.
showcase.web_desc: Self-contained web page — Kami-inspired, responsive, centered layout. Card row with SVG faces, white chapter cards with subtle shadows. No external JS, works offline.
showcase.social_desc: 1080×1440 social card carousel — Kami-inspired, optimized for Xiaohongshu and social sharing. Cover page with title + card display, compressed content pages with insight boxes. 4 pages per reading.
spreads.heading: Spread Types
spreads.title: Six ways to read
spreads.s1_desc: Single card with clear verdict — YES, NO, or MAYBE, with nuanced interpretation.
spreads.s2_desc: Read as one combined sentence — Noun + Adjective model in its purest form.
spreads.s3_desc: Chained pairs with a central synthesis. Classic daily reading format.
spreads.s4_desc: Center card as core theme, four chained pairs, one narrative trajectory.
spreads.s5_desc: Triple perspective: Time Axis by columns, Three Layers by rows, and Cross Method.
spreads.s6_desc: Two parallel 3-card chains, side-by-side comparison. Choice stays with the querent.
